cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only Sonnet/Haiku audit is complete; a second design review is underway. Do not infer research completion, oracle readiness, or activation. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 567fb435 adds source-only provider fanout and focused tests, but those tests have not run. Commit 62550164 adds fail-closed route/status/frontend guards; they are uncompiled and unrun. Earlier pure account/reserve, transaction-ledger, and exact deposit-receipt matching helpers also remain without independent provider configuration/wiring or live calls. Direct provider endpoint probes could not run under local DNS sandbox; candidates remain unvalidated. The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before these changes. No actual Horizon outcall or live deposit credit exists. Pending claim/intent records are dormant state only, not a lifecycle. No vault/deposit/claim lifecycle, XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: A source scaffold adds a Frozen NativeXlm config constructor that clones risk/curve fields from a supplied current XRP config, sets XLM to 7 decimals and a 1 XLM minimum, and clears observations. State config tests passed 2/2 and legacy custody decode passed 1/1 before the latest route/reserve-binding changes. Generic update_collateral_config rejects both the canonical XLM key and NativeXlm. Persistent serde-defaulted XlmPendingDeposit state and permanent receipt data exist; prior CBOR round-trip/old-snapshot default test passed 1/1. Commit 445ebec4 adds pure 2-of-3 transaction-ledger matching and exact deposit-receipt helpers, but neither is wired into live processing or Cargo-tested. Claim/intent records remain dormant: they do not drive a live flow, create credit, or prove provider quorum. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Earlier source changes added fail-closed guards to generic ICRC entrypoints and unsupported borrow/full-liquidation/repay-close/push-sweep fallbacks. Commit 62550164 adds further source-only fail-closed route/status/frontend guards; these changes are uncompiled and unrun. Mara Junior's first read-only deposit-proof audit is complete, but a second design review remains underway. WP3 remains blocked because no XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or live credit lifecycle exists; claim/intent records remain dormant, and Frozen config and generic update denial keep XLM unreachable. No XLM admission is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commits 6da8cd46 and 3e12fba5 add source-level fail-closed handling for unsupported XLM withdrawal, close, full-liquidation, repay-close, and push-sweep fallback routes. Commit 62550164 adds further source-only fail-closed route/status/frontend guards; uncompiled and unrun. Mara Junior's first read-only XRP claim-reuse audit is complete, with second design review underway. Claim/intent state remains dormant only. WP4 remains blocked because no supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Frozen config and generic update denial prevent XLM admission now.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Candid regeneration passed with `RUMI_REGEN_DID=1 cargo +1.92.0 test --locked -p rumi_protocol_backend --bin rumi_protocol_backend check_candid_interface_compatibility -- --exact --nocapture`; `scripts/regenerate-declarations.sh rumi_protocol_backend` ran, and the non-regeneration compatibility test passed. No XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, or claim endpoints or user flows are present. Keep interface and lifecycle work in progress.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: The plan status paragraph was clarified in commit 70bae78b: focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 at an earlier source state. Commits 567fb435 (provider fanout and tests) and 62550164 (route/status/frontend fail-closed guards) are source-only and uncompiled/unrun; do not treat the earlier test result as validating them. Existing quorum/matching helpers remain unwired, with no independent provider config or live calls. The deterministic `last_modified_ledger` transform is historical reserve evidence only. Direct endpoint probes were blocked by local DNS sandbox; candidates remain unvalidated and there is no live credit. Mara Junior's first read-only audit is complete and second design review is underway. WP3/WP4 remain blocked; no registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Mara Junior's first read-only release-prerequisite Sonnet/Haiku audit is complete; a second design review is underway. Release remains blocked until implementation, exact-head review and CI, artifact verification, audit disposition, rollback and monitoring plans, and current Stellar oracle quorum, reserve, fee, provider, and key checks are evidenced. XRC XLM/USD live quorum is unproven. Deployment and activation remain separate proof points from signing, broadcasting, and moving funds.
